artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the yellow sign ('Silver St.') is legible but exhibits slight warping and irregular character spacing typical of AI generation. The smaller text below it is nearly illegible gibberish.

The wet road reflections are overly smooth and painterly. The reflection of the red light on the wet asphalt lacks the complex scattering seen in real photography, appearing as a simple blurred gradient.

The suspended traffic lights in the distance lack clear definition. The housings blend slightly into the background trees/wires, and the lens shapes are somewhat distorted/oval rather than perfectly circular.
